scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online. My name is Sprakki and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] to continue.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你好！欢迎来到《仙境传说》。
我叫斯普拉奇，负责向你介绍基本的游戏操作。
点击[下一步]按钮或按[回车]键继续。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dffmoves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
首先，你得学会控制角色的基本操作。
所有的^4d4dff移动、物品选择和攻击^000000都使用^4d4dff鼠标左键^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
点击地面即可移动角色。
点击魔物即可攻击，点击其他人即可与他们交谈。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First off, try moving around.
Do you see that wooden bridge to the right?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
先试着四处走走。
看到右边那座木桥了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Walk over that bridge and there's a castle used as the Training Center.
I will be waiting for you inside of that Castle. Please come to the castle by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
走过那座桥，前面有一座城堡，那就是训练中心。
我会在里面等你。请自己走过去。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Sprakki.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
你接到了斯普拉奇交给你的任务。
可以在任务信息窗口查看任务内容。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will wait inside the Training Center across the bridge.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我会在桥对面的训练中心里等你。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You can open the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000 keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
同时按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000即可打开任务信息窗口。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
I'll be waiting in the castle across the bridge.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
查看过任务信息窗口了吗？
我会在桥对面的城堡里等你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will be waiting for you across the Bridge to the east.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我会在东边那座桥的另一头等你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Are you lost?
Have you gone beyond the bridge to the east?
I will guide you further after we meet in the Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
迷路了吗？
你过了东边那座桥吗？
到训练中心和我碰面后，我再继续指导你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online.
My name is Sprakki and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] key to continue.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你好！欢迎来到《仙境传说》。
我叫斯普拉奇，负责向你介绍基本的游戏操作。
点击[下一步]按钮或按[回车]键继续。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dffmoves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
首先，你得学会控制角色的基本操作。
所有的^4d4dff移动、物品选择和攻击^000000都使用^4d4dff鼠标左键^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
点击地面即可移动角色。
点击魔物即可攻击，点击其他人即可与他们交谈。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Well then, I will give you a quest to talk to me.
After the conversation is over, talk to me again by left-clicking on me.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我先给你一个和我对话的任务。
这段对话结束后，再用鼠标左键点我一次。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Sprakki.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000 keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
你接到了斯普拉奇交给你的任务。
同时按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000打开任务信息窗口，即可查看任务内容。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
Well, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
查看过任务信息窗口了吗？
好了，再和我谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Great!
Now you know how to move and talk to others, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
很好！
现在你知道怎么移动和与人交谈了吧？

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
The Training Center is prepared for novices just like you.
You are going to be trained to get used to the basics of the Game.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
训练中心是为你这样的初心者准备的。
你可以在这里接受训练，熟悉游戏的基本操作。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Of course, this Training Process is optional, if you want to go straight to town, that's also fine.
But, you will miss all the advantages you can get in the Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
当然，训练并非强制。如果你想直接进城也没问题，不过就会错过在训练中心能获得的各种好处。

scripts.text: Begin Training.
scripts.translation: 开始训练

scripts.text: Start the game right away.
scripts.translation: 直接开始游戏

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will guide you to the Novice Training Center.
Inside, Instructor 'Brade' will be waiting to speak to you.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我带你去初心者训练中心。
布雷德指导员会在那里等你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Instructor 'Brade' will help you afterwards.
Please, Go see him.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
接下来布雷德指导员会帮助你。
快去找他吧。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You received a quest 'Novice Training Ground -1' from Sprakki.
Please check the Quest Info Window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 你接到了斯普拉奇交给你的任务“初心者训练场 -1”。
请查看任务信息窗口。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Ok, You want to start right away.
Which Town do you want to start at?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
好，你想直接开始游戏。
想从哪个城镇出发？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 梦罗克

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I see.
Go ahead and grow stronger! Look toward a brighter future ahead of you.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我知道了。
去努力变强吧，前方还有更美好的未来等着你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
These are the Novice Training Grounds.
I will guide you to the Novice Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
这里是初心者训练场。
我带你去初心者训练中心。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online.
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
你好！欢迎来到《仙境传说》。
你之前参加过旧训练场的训练。
现在训练场已经换了新的管理者。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
I guess we will just have to start your training all over again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
看来得从头再训练你一遍了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
My name is Instructor Brade and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] to continue.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
我叫布雷德指导员，负责教你基本的游戏操作。
点击[下一步]按钮或按[回车]键继续。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dff moves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
首先，你得学会控制角色的基本操作。
所有的^4d4dff移动、物品选择和攻击^000000都使用^4d4dff鼠标左键^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
点击地面即可移动角色。
点击魔物即可攻击，点击其他人即可与他们交谈。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First off, try moving around.
After moving around, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
先试着移动一下。
移动完再和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Instructor Brade.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
你接到了布雷德指导员交给你的任务。
可以在任务信息窗口查看任务内容。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You can open the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 信息 !-
同时按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000即可打开任务信息窗口。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
Well, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
查看过任务信息窗口了吗？
好了，再和我谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Great.
You've completed the given quest successfully, so I will reward you with experience points.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
很好。
你顺利完成了任务，我会奖励你经验值。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Experience Points you've earned from hunting or finishing quests can be checked by tracking the EXP Bar, located at upper-left side of the display.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
狩猎或完成任务获得的经验值，可以通过查看屏幕左上角的经验值条来确认。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Sigh... I will just talk roughly.
...I just can't get used to 'politeness' you know.
Don't look at me like that!
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
唉...我还是随便说吧。
我就是不习惯“客气”的那一套。
别那样看我！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Ok look alive you maggot.
Next up is items and equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
喂，臭虫，打起精神来。
接下来讲物品和装备。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First, take these.
These are very basic equipments and recovery potions.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
先拿着这些。
这是最基本的装备和恢复药水。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Uh... Where were we? Oh right, let's continue.
It's about items and equipments.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
呃...刚才说到哪儿了？哦，对，继续。
我们要讲物品和装备。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Take these.
Basic equipments and recovery potions.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
拿着这些。
这是基础装备和恢复药水。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
In the upper left Basic Info. Window, press the 'Item' icon to open the Item Window.
The item window is divided into...
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
点击左上角基本信息窗口里的“物品”图标，即可打开物品窗口。
物品窗口分为...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
3 sections: consumable items, equipment and other items.
If you want to use or equip items, just double-click on the item or drag them into the Equipment Window.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
三个分页：消耗品、装备和其他物品。
双击物品即可使用或装备，也可以把装备拖到装备窗口。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You can see detailed info. of each item by right-clicking on the item.
Detailed information of the item will pop up.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
右键点击物品可以查看详细信息。
届时会弹出该物品的详细说明。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Right-click on an item to see detailed information about it.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
右键点击物品，即可查看详细信息。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Right-click on other players to show the Community Menu and you can join a party, or request trade with a player etc.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
右键点击其他玩家可打开社交菜单，从中加入队伍、发起交易等。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Why don't you equip the items I gave you earlier?
^4d4dffDouble-Click^000000 on the item you want to equip. Let us continue after you are done gearing up.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
把我刚才给你的装备穿上吧。
^4d4dff双击^000000要装备的物品。等你整理好装备，我们再继续。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Items can be easily equipped or used by simply double-clicking on them.
The Hot Key to open the Inventory Window is ALT + E.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
双击物品即可轻松使用或装备。
按 ALT + E 打开物品窗口。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
To check on the items that are currently equipped, use the Hot Key ALT + Q.
Or, drag the item on to the item slot you want the item to be equipped.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
按 ALT + Q 查看当前装备。
也可以把物品拖到对应的装备栏位。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Equip all of the equipment given by Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
把布雷德指导员给你的装备都穿戴起来。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Try to put on at least 4 of the equipments I gave you.
Put those shoes on, wear those clothes, and arm yourself with that weapon you maggot.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
至少穿上我给你的4件装备。
把鞋穿好、衣服穿上，再拿起武器，臭虫。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You are all set.
You are coming along just fine.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
准备好了。
进展不错。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Here's some Fly Wings and Butterfly Wings as a reward.
You don't need these in the Training Ground, but they will come in handy later.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
这是给你的奖励：苍蝇翅膀和蝴蝶翅膀。
你在训练场用不到它们，不过以后会派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Next, are Hot Keys.
Press the ^4d4dffF12 key^000000 on your keyboard.
A box with 9 slots will pop up.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
接下来讲快捷键。
按下键盘上的^4d4dffF12键^000000。
屏幕上会出现一个有9个栏位的窗口。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Drag on the right corner of the Hot Key Window and you will be able to see the other pages of the Hot Key.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
拖动快捷键窗口右下角的箭头，即可切换其他快捷键页面。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
The F1 to F9 keys are the designated hotkeys.
Just drag a skill or an item onto the Hot Key Window and press a corresponding key to use them right away.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
F1到F9是指定的快捷键。
把技能或物品拖到快捷键窗口，再按对应按键即可使用。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
You can register a skill or an item to the Hot Key Window by just dragging them onto the Hot Key Slot.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
将技能或物品拖到快捷键栏位，即可登记到快捷键窗口。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Registered Skills or Items can be used/equipped by just pressing the corresponding key.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
按下对应按键，即可使用或装备登记好的技能和物品。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
You can customize the Hot Key to use any keys you please as the Hot Key by changing the Shortcut configuration in the options menu.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
在选项菜单中调整快捷键设置，就能按自己的习惯自定义按键。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Register skills and items that you use often so that you can use them easily.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
把常用的技能和物品登记到快捷键，使用起来会更方便。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
The last part is how to use Skills.
But before that, you need to learn something first.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
最后要讲的是技能的使用方法。
不过在此之前，你还得先学点东西。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Somewhere in this room, there's someone named ^4d4dffJinha^000000.
Find Jinha and learn the ^4d4dff[First Aid]^000000 skill from him.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
这个房间里有个叫^4d4dff振河^000000的人。
去找他学习^4d4dff[紧急治疗]^000000技能。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Your lesson is after that.
Go find Jinha and learn the [First Aid] Skill. Then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
之后还要上我的课。
先去找振河学习[紧急治疗]，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Somewhere in this room, there's someone named ^4d4dffJinha^000000.
Find Jinha and learn the ^4d4dff[First Aid]^000000 skill from him.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
这个房间里有个叫^4d4dff振河^000000的人。
去找他学习^4d4dff[紧急治疗]^000000技能。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Now you've learned the [First Aid] Skill.
Just as I told you before, by registering the First Aid Skill onto the Hot Key Window, you can use the skill fast and easy.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
现在你已经学会[紧急治疗]了。
把技能登记到快捷键窗口，就能快速方便地使用。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
And that's it, that's all I can teach you.
You see that exit to the west?
Move on to the next room and there will be another instructor waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
我能教你的就这些了。
看到西边的出口了吗？前往下一个房间，另一位指导员会在那里等你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
We will be seeing each other soon enough.
But for now, go to the room to the west and get more information.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
我们很快会再见的。
现在先去西边的房间了解更多吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You've come along fine this far.
This is not much, but take this as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
你一路表现得不错。
这点东西不算什么，收下当奖励吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Next step of the Training is done in the room west of here.
If you are lost, I can send you there.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
下一阶段训练在西边的房间进行。
如果你迷路了，我可以送你过去。

scripts.text: I can get there by myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己能过去

scripts.text: Please, send me to the next room.
scripts.translation: 请把我送到下一个房间

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Good. That's the attitude you must have.
You can't just lean on others to help you.
Now, go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
很好，就该有这样的态度。
不能总指望别人帮你。
去吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Oh well.
I think it's better than seeing you lost and wandering about.
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
好吧。
总比看着你迷路、到处乱转强。
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Aren't you done with the courses here?
Or are you just lost?
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
这里的课程还没上完吗？
还是你迷路了？

scripts.text: Send me to the Combat Training Ground.
scripts.translation: 送我去战斗训练场

scripts.text: I want to go to town.
scripts.translation: 我想去城镇

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Sure.
Be careful not to be lost again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
好吧。
小心别又迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Town... Eh?
In that case, I will send you to where the Kafra Employee is at.
Use ^4d4dffKafra's Warp Service^000000 to go to town.
scripts.translation:
[指导员布雷德]
城镇？嗯...
那我把你送到卡普拉服务人员那里。
使用^4d4dff卡普拉传送服务^000000就能前往城镇。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
What can I help you with?
Hmm? You haven't followed the curriculum correctly.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
有什么可以帮你的吗？
嗯？你没有按课程顺序来啊。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
You have to see Instructor Brade first before me. I will send you to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你得先去见布雷德指导员，再来找我。我送你回他那里。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Hello!
I am responsible for teaching you the [First Aid] skill.
Instructor Brade asked you to learn it right?.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你好！
我负责教你[紧急治疗]技能。
布雷德指导员让你来学这个技能，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Wow... ...it's amazing!
You already know the First Aid Skill.
There doesn't seem to be anything for me to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
哇... ...真厉害！
你已经学会紧急治疗了。
看来我没什么可教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Great. Was your instructor from the previous management Cecil?
Well, you have learned First Aid, I can confirm that.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
很好。你之前的教官是塞西尔吧？
嗯，我确认过了，你已经学会紧急治疗。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Well, you can directly go to the next step of the course.
Go back to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
那你可以直接进入课程的下一阶段了。
回去找布雷德指导员吧。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Hello!
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你好！
有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: I want to learn to use the [First Aid] Skill.
scripts.translation: 我想学习[紧急治疗]技能

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
That's right.
First Aid is the skill used to convert SP into HP when you are in danger.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
没错。
遇到危险时，可以使用紧急治疗把SP转化成HP。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
It's recovery amount is small.
Still, it will help you not to faint from a critical hit.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
恢复量虽然不多，
但至少能让你在受到重击时不至于倒下。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
You can open the Skill Window by pressing the ^4d4dffskill^000000 button in the Basic Window.
Hot Key is ^4d4dffALT + S^000000.
Why don't you try the skill?
scripts.translation:
[振河]
点击基本信息窗口里的^4d4dff技能^000000按钮，即可打开技能窗口。
快捷键是^4d4dffALT + S^000000。
试着使用一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Good, now you know how to use the First Aid Skill, you have to move on to the next step.
Go back to Instructor Brade and show him what you've learned here.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
很好，既然你学会了使用紧急治疗，就该进行下一阶段了。
回去找布雷德指导员，给他看看你学到的技能。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Didn't you learn the First Aid Skill already?
Have it checked by Instructor Brade.
If you don't know how to get to him, I will send you to him.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你不是已经学会紧急治疗了吗？
让布雷德指导员检查一下。
不知道怎么过去的话，我可以送你去。

scripts.text: I'm good by myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己去就行

scripts.text: Please, send me to him.
scripts.translation: 请把我送过去

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Very Good!
That's the right attitude!
You will be a great adventurer in the future.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
很好！
这态度就对了！
将来你一定会成为出色的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
I will send you to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
我送你去布雷德指导员那里。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
What can I do for you?
Next course will be continued in the West Room.
Go on into the west room.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
有什么可以帮你的吗？
下一阶段的课程在西边的房间。
去那边看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Hmm? Strange.
Let me see that Trainee ID for a sec.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
嗯？奇怪。
让我看看你的学员证。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Oh, really...
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
哦，原来如此...
你参加过旧训练场的训练。
现在训练场已经换了新的管理者。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
If you want to do the basic course,
you should go back to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
想上基础课程的话，
就回去找布雷德指导员吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Or you can go ahead and start with theory training.
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你也可以直接开始理论训练。
想选哪一个？

scripts.text: Send me to Basic Training.
scripts.translation: 送我去基础训练

scripts.text: Start Theory Training.
scripts.translation: 开始理论训练

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure.
I will send you to Instructor Brade.
Instructor Brade will start your basic training.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。
我送你去布雷德指导员那里。
他会带你开始基础训练。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will tell you about the people you will be seeing in Town.
There are many kinds of people in town and some of them will be helpful to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我来介绍一下你在城镇里会遇到的人。
城镇里有形形色色的人，认识其中一些会对你有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
There are a lot of people in town, but among them, these people are the most important to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
城镇里的人很多，不过有几位特别值得认识。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
They are [Kafra] Employee's standing right behind me and their rival company the [Cool Event Corp].
When you visit a town for the first time, you should talk to the Information [Guide]
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
站在我身后的是[卡普拉]员工，旁边是她们的竞争对手[酷活动公司]。
第一次来到城镇时，记得先和信息向导交谈。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Well then, let's hear from each of them.
Start by talking to the [Kafra] Employee.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接下来听听他们各自的介绍吧。
先去和[卡普拉]员工谈谈。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You've received a quest from Chocolat.
Please check the quest information window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 你接到了巧克力交给你的任务。
请查看任务信息窗口。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You were still on the basic course.
You should go back to Instructor Brade or Jinha.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你的基础课程还没完成。
回去找布雷德指导员或振河吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
If you don't know how to find them, I can send you to Instructor Brade, How about it?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
不知道他们在哪里的话，我可以送你去布雷德指导员那里。怎么样？

scripts.text: I will go myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己过去

scripts.text: Will you do that for me?
scripts.translation: 请帮我传送过去

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure. Go out to the door to the right.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。请从右边的门出去。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure.
I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will tell you about the people you will be seeing in Town.
There are many kinds of people in town and some of them will be helpful to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我来介绍一下你在城镇里会遇到的人。
城镇里有形形色色的人，认识其中一些会对你有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
There are a lot of people in town, but among them, these people are the most important to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
城镇里的人很多，其中有几位特别值得认识。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
They are [Kafra] Employee's standing right behind me and their rival company the [Cool Event Corp].
When you visit a town for the first time, you should talk to Information [Guide]
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
站在我身后的是[卡普拉]员工，旁边是她们的竞争对手[酷活动公司]。
第一次来到城镇时，记得先和信息向导交谈。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Well then, let's hear from each of them.
Start by talking to the [Kafra] Employee.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接下来听听他们各自的介绍吧。
先去和[卡普拉]员工谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Here, talk to these guys standing behind me.
Start with the [Kafra] Employee behind me.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
来，和站在我身后的这些人交谈吧。
先从[卡普拉]员工开始。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You've learned a lot about Kafra service huh?
From now on, you can use the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
看来你已经了解不少卡普拉服务了。
今后就可以使用这些服务了。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
During the Training Process, if you want to go straight to the town, you can use the Kafra Service to go there.
But, once you leave the Training Center, you can never come back here.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
训练期间，如果想直接前往城镇，可以使用卡普拉服务。
不过，一旦离开训练中心，就再也回不来了。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Next is the Kafra's rival, [Cool Event Corp.] Staff!
[Cool Event Corp.] Staff specialize in events.
Well, why don't you talk to him yourself?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接下来介绍卡普拉的竞争对手——[酷活动公司]职员！
[酷活动公司]职员专门负责各种活动。
你自己去和他聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
After [Kafra] and [Cool Event Corp.], are the Information [Guide]'s.
They can seem insignificant but they can help you greatly when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接着是信息向导。
他们看起来不起眼，关键时刻却能帮上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I've brought the Information Guide from the City of Prontera.
Ask him what he actually does in town.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我从普隆德拉请来了这位信息向导。
问问他在城镇里具体负责什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
How was the explanation of the Information [Guide]?
Last is about using [Inn]s.
There's an Inn located in each town.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
信息向导介绍得怎么样？
最后要讲讲[旅馆]。
每个城镇都有旅馆。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You can rest at Inns or Hotels for a small fee.
Your HP and SP will be recovered completely by resting there.
Can't hurt to use one, eh?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你可以花少量费用在旅馆休息，完全恢复HP和SP。
试试也无妨，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Besides these guys, there's many merchants selling various kind of items, so go check them out.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
除此之外，城里还有许多商人出售各种物品，记得去看看。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You've completed all the quests I gave you.
As the reward, I will give you Free Tickets for Kafra Storage and Teleport Service.
They will come in handy.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你已经完成了我交给你的所有任务。
作为奖励，我送你卡普拉仓库服务券和传送服务券。以后会用得上的。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
That's all for me.
Now, it's time for real combat!
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我的介绍就到这里。
接下来该进行真正的战斗了！

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Real Combat Training will be given by Instructor Brade. You met him earlier.
I will send you to the Real Combat Training Field.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
真正的战斗训练由布雷德指导员负责，你之前见过他。
我送你去实战训练场。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Are you lost?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
迷路了吗？

scripts.text: No, just looking around
scripts.translation: 没有，我只是四处看看

scripts.text: Yes, send me to the Combat Training Field
scripts.translation: 是的，请送我去实战训练场

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Okay, come back to me if
you need me to redirect you.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。如果还需要我指路，就回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will send you to the Real Combat Training Field.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我送你去实战训练场。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello.
I don't think it's my turn yet.
Please talk to 'Chocolat' first.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
你好。
好像还没轮到我。
请先和巧克力谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello.
I've been dispatched by the Kafra Head Office to help trainees.
The Kafra Corporation is the world's largest company with a long and distinguished history on the Midgard continent.
It's important for you adventurers to be close with us.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
你好。
我是卡普拉总公司派来协助学员的职员。
卡普拉公司历史悠久，是米德加尔特大陆规模最大的企业。
冒险者们可少不了我们的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I will inform you about the Kafra Services which you will be using most frequently, [Save], [Storage] and [Teleport] Services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
我来介绍你最常用的几项服务：[存档]、[仓库]和[传送]。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you talk to a Kafra Employee and ask for the Save Service,
the location of where you will revive, after being defeated in battle, will be changed.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
和卡普拉职员交谈并使用存档服务后，你在战斗中被击败时的复活地点就会变更。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Your Respawn Point is always the last place where you have saved. Using a Butterfly Wing will return you to the place where you last saved.
This service is free to use, so feel free to use the Save Service anytime you like.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
你的复活点始终是最近一次存档的地点。使用蝴蝶翅膀也会回到那里。
存档服务免费，随时都可以使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Do you want to hear another explanation?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
还想了解其他服务吗？

scripts.text: About Save
scripts.translation: 关于存档

scripts.text: About Storage
scripts.translation: 关于仓库

scripts.text: About Teleport
scripts.translation: 关于传送

scripts.text: About Cart
scripts.translation: 关于手推车

scripts.text: No More.
scripts.translation: 没有其他问题

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I hope you are satisfied with my explanation
about the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
希望我的介绍能让你满意。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Kafra Service at your service.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
卡普拉服务随时为您效劳。
请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Let me inform you before you use the Teleport Service.
If you teleport to the village,
^4d4dffyou can NEVER come back to the Novice Training Field.^000000
So keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
使用传送服务前，请先听我提醒。
传送到村庄后，
^4d4dff你将永远无法返回初心者训练场。^000000
请务必记住。

scripts.text: Teleport Service
scripts.translation: 传送服务

scripts.text: About Kafra Service
scripts.translation: 关于卡普拉服务

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So, you are going straight to town.
Let me give you a brief introduction.
^4d4dffProntera is the Capital City of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, and right next to it is Izlude^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
您要直接前往城镇吗？
我先简单介绍一下。
^4d4dff普隆德拉是卢恩·米德加兹王国的首都，依斯鲁得岛就在附近。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^4d4dffMorocc is the Desert City, you can change your job to Thief and Assassin^000000 here.
^4d4dffPayon is the Village in the Mountains, and it is close to the Archer Village^000000.
^4d4dffGeffen is the City of Magic. Go there if you want to become a Mage.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
^4d4dff梦罗克是沙漠之城，您可以在此转职为盗贼或刺客。^000000
^4d4dff斐扬是山中的村庄，弓箭手村就在附近。^000000
^4d4dff吉芬是魔法之城。想成为魔法师的话，就去那里吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^4d4dffAlberta is the Port City and there you can find the Merchant Guild^000000.
Also, if you are trying to take a boat to go somewhere, you have to go through Alberta first.
Select the town you want to teleport to.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
^4d4dff艾尔贝塔是港口城市，也是商人公会所在地。^000000
想乘船前往其他地方的话，得先到艾尔贝塔。
请选择要传送的城镇。

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 梦罗克

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Rune-Midgarts' Capital, Prontera.
I will send you to Prontera.
May Freya bless you upon your journey.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
卢恩·米德加兹王国的首都——普隆德拉。
我这就送您过去。
愿芙蕾雅保佑您的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Desert City, Morocc...
It has lost it's former glory...
Do not lose the dream in your heart right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
沙漠之城梦罗克...
它已失去昔日的辉煌...
但愿您不要放弃心中的梦想。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hmm, you want to be an Archer?.
Let's go to Payon.
Let Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
嗯，您想成为弓箭手吗？
那我们就去斐扬吧。
愿芙蕾雅保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Port City, Alberta.
Main city for all trades on the Midgard continent.
If you want to experience other civilizations, you have to visit Alberta first.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
艾尔贝塔是港口城市，也是米德加尔特大陆的贸易中心。
想体验其他文明，就先去一趟艾尔贝塔吧。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The City of Magic!
Geffen Tower is looking nice standing in the middle of Geffen City.
I will send you close to the Geffen fountain.
May Goddess Freya bless you!.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
魔法之城！
吉芬塔矗立在城镇中央，十分壮观。
我会把您送到吉芬喷泉附近。
愿芙蕾雅保佑您！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I will explain about the Kafra Service.
Which Service do you want to be
informed about?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
我来介绍卡普拉服务。
您想了解哪项服务？

scripts.text: About Save
scripts.translation: 关于存档

scripts.text: About Storage
scripts.translation: 关于仓库

scripts.text: About Teleport
scripts.translation: 关于传送

scripts.text: About Cart
scripts.translation: 关于手推车

scripts.text: No More.
scripts.translation: 没有其他问题

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I hope you are satisfied with my explanation
about the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
希望我的介绍能让您满意。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you are killed in a battle,
you can revive in the location you saved with this service.
If you save at a Kafra in each village
You can revive in the village you saved.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
战斗中不幸倒下时，
可以通过这项服务在存档点复活。
只要在各村庄的卡普拉处存档，
就能在对应村庄复活。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Saved location is always where
you saved last, and by using a Butterfly Wing,
you can teleport directly to your saved point.
So feel free to use this service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
存档点始终是您最近一次存档的位置。
使用蝴蝶翅膀即可直接传送到存档点。
欢迎使用这项服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Next is about using the Storage Service.
You can store and retrieve your items in any town at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
接下来介绍仓库服务。
您可以在任何城镇方便地存取物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
It's unreasonable to carry all of your items with you when you don't need them right away.
Please use our Storage and keep your items safe and secure.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
不需要马上使用的物品，没必要一直带在身上。
请使用我们的仓库，妥善保管物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Our convenient Storage Service
is provided to our customers for a small fee which is different from town to town.
However, you must be
at least ^3355FFBasic Skill Level 6^000000
to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
使用便捷的仓库服务只需支付少量费用，
具体费用因城镇而异。
不过，您的^3355FF基本技能等级必须达到 6 级^000000，
才能使用仓库。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are 7 different item sections of the Storage into which items are organized: Consumable, Kafra (Item Mall), Armor, Weapons, Ammo, Cards, and Etc items.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
仓库分为 7 个物品分类：消耗品、卡普拉商城、防具、武器、弹药、卡片和其他。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are a maximum of {0} Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage, meaning you can have up to {1} different kinds of items in Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
卡普拉仓库最多有 {0} 个物品栏位，
也就是说，最多可以存放 {1} 种不同的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
If you have a Premium Subscription, the maximum Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage is {0}!
Remember though, that in the case of Equipment, each item takes up one Inventory Slot.
The maximum number of items that can be placed in Kafra Storage is 30,000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
如果您订阅了高级服务，卡普拉仓库的物品栏位上限为 {0}！
请注意，每件装备都会单独占用一个物品栏位。
卡普拉仓库最多可存放 30,000 件物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are a maximum of {0} Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage, meaning you can have up to {1} different kinds of items in Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
卡普拉仓库最多有 {0} 个物品栏位，
也就是说，最多可以存放 {1} 种不同的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This Storage is shared by every character on one account.
Storage Fees can be vary for each Town.
So please keep that in mind when you are using our storage service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
同一账号下的所有角色共用这个仓库。
仓库费用因城镇而异，
使用时请留意。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We also provide you with a Teleport Service to make your trips easier when you are trying to move a long distance.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
我们还提供传送服务，
方便您进行长距离移动。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
With our veteran teleporter's skill,
your trip will be safer and more comfortable.
Oh and remember that the places you can teleport to vary from town to town.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
凭借资深传送员的本领，
您的旅途会更加安全舒适。
请注意，各城镇可传送的目的地有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This is all for your never ending
support. We are working hard to
repay our dept to our customers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
感谢您一直以来的支持。
我们正努力回馈每一位顾客。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra corporation provides Cart rental services
to customers engaged in commercial business.
Originally this cart rental service had been only provided
by the merchant guild in Alberta
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
卡普拉公司为从事商业活动的顾客提供手推车租赁服务。
最初，这项服务仅由艾尔贝塔的商人公会提供。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
However, since we took over this service
our merchant customers have been able to rent carts from almost anywhere.
The cart rental service is available only for job classes engaged in commercial business
such as ^4d4dffMerchants, Blacksmiths, Alchemists, and Super Novices^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
自从我们接手这项服务后，
商人顾客几乎可以在任何地方租用手推车。
只有从事商业活动的职业才能租用手推车，
例如^4d4dff商人、铁匠、炼金术士和超级初心者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Of course you should learn the 'Pushcart' skill beforehand,
otherwise you will not be able to rent a cart from us.
The rental fee varies by town,
please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
当然，您得先学会“手推车使用”技能，
才能向我们租用手推车。
租金因城镇而异，
请留意。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
This is not my turn.
have you finished talking to the Kafra Employee yet?
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
还没轮到我。
您和卡普拉职员谈完了吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Hello.
We are working hard to provide events on Midgard similar to the Kafra services.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您好。
我们正在努力在米德加尔特举办活动，提供类似卡普拉的服务。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Our staff is here to support you with [storage], [save] and [teleport service].
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
我们的职员可以为您提供[仓库]、[存档]和[传送服务]。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
If there's no Kafra around you, we're around to help you.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
附近没有卡普拉时，就由我们来帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
We are working hard on a network of Events to make your life better.
I hope that you can meet our staff in Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
我们正努力拓展活动服务网络，让您的生活更加便利。
希望您能在艾尔贝塔见到我们的职员。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Who knows, we might meet outside of this academy.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
谁知道呢，说不定我们会在学院外碰面。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Mostly all of us wear red coats in the places that the Kafra Employee's don't work in.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
在卡普拉职员无法提供服务的地方，我们大多穿着红色外套。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Most of our services are similar to those of the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
我们的服务大多与卡普拉公司相似。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It ain't my turn yet.
Listen to Chocolat.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
还没轮到我。
请先听巧克力说明。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Guides are in each town to guide you to useful places.
Ask us where you want to go and we'll mark your mini maps with a ^4d4dff+^000000.
Don't hesitate to ask us questions.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
每个城镇都有向导，为您指引有用的地点。
告诉我们您想去哪里，我们会在小地图上标出一个^4d4dff+^000000。
有问题尽管问。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
We all don't look the same in every town but our roles are the same.
Take note of this whenever you go to a new town.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
各城镇的向导外貌可能不同，但职责相同。
到了新的城镇，记得留意我们。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If you want to go to your first town, you can ask the Kafra Employee to the left.
You can move there with the Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
想去第一个城镇的话，可以询问左边的卡普拉职员。
使用传送服务就能前往。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
What can I help you with?
Need me to explain what I do again?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
有什么可以帮您？
要我再介绍一下自己的职责吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I need an explanation.
scripts.translation: 是的，请再介绍一下。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Guides are in each town to guide you to useful places in each town.
Ask us where you want to go and we'll mark your mini maps with a ^4d4dff+^000000.
Don't hesitate to ask us questions.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
每个城镇都有向导，为您指引当地的有用地点。
告诉我们您想去哪里，我们会在小地图上标出一个^4d4dff+^000000。
有问题尽管问。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
We all don't look the same in every town but our roles are the same.
Take note of this whenever you go to a new town.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
各城镇的向导外貌可能不同，但职责相同。
到了新的城镇，记得留意我们。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If you want to go to your first town, you can ask the Kafra Employee to the left.
You can move there with the Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
想去第一个城镇的话，可以询问左边的卡普拉职员。
使用传送服务就能前往。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Ok well talk to Chocolat if you're done talking with us.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
好的，谈完后请去找巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您参加过以前的训练场课程。
训练场现在已经换了新的管理团队。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Do you want to do the basic course,
or do you just want to go through from here?
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您想参加基础课程，
还是直接从这里开始？

scripts.text: Send me to Basic Training.
scripts.translation: 送我去基础训练

scripts.text: I'll start from here.
scripts.translation: 我就从这里开始

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Ok. I'll send you to the basic course.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
好，我送您去基础课程。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then we will start your training.
I'll write down the registration form.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
那么，我们开始训练吧。
我来填写登记表。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
I think you came back from theory training course,
can I send you back to there or do you just want to go through from here?
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
我想您是从理论训练课程回来的。
要我送您回去，还是直接从这里开始？

scripts.text: Send me back to Chocolat.
scripts.translation: 送我回巧克力那里

scripts.text: I'll start from here.
scripts.translation: 我就从这里开始

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Ok. I'll send you to Chocolat.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
好，我送您去巧克力那里。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then we will start your training.
I'll write down the registration form.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
那么，我们开始训练吧。
我来填写登记表。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Welcome.
Now this is real practice.
We can practice real battle here.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
欢迎。
现在开始真正的实战训练。
我们可以在这里练习战斗。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
As I explained the first time, we can click on the monsters.
One attack per click.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
就像我之前说的，点击魔物即可攻击。
每点击一次，攻击一次。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
For convenience,
^4d4dffIf you hold down the Ctrl key,^000000 while attacking, you will automatically attack.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
为了方便，
攻击时按住^4d4dffCtrl 键，^000000角色就会自动攻击。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You can also set this mode before battle by typing ^4d4dff[ /nc ]^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您也可以在战斗前输入^4d4dff[ /nc ]^000000来开启此模式。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then, let's go Poring hunting.
Please hunt 'Poring's on Level 1 of the training grounds.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
接下来去猎杀波利吧。
请在训练场第 1 层猎杀波利。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You've received a quest from Instructor Brade.
Please check the quest information window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 您接到了指导员布雷德发布的任务。
请查看任务信息窗口。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You can see it is not so hard, huh?
Nice job.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
看起来不难吧？
做得好。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Kill enough Porings.
Porings are easy to deal with, so cheer up.
Try again.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
再击败一些波利。
波利很好对付，加油。
再试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Now all of the courses are almost done.
You are a Novice, and you can't get any jobs yet.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
课程差不多都结束了。
您现在还是初心者，尚未达到转职条件。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
If you acquire all of basic skills with JOB Level 10, you can change your job.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
职业等级达到 10 级并学会所有基本技能后，就可以转职了。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The first Job classes are defined into 6 classes.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
第一职业分为 6 种。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The 6 basic jobs are
Swordman, Thief,
Acolyte, Mage,
Archer and Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
6 种基础职业是：
剑士、盗贼、
服事、魔法师、
弓箭手和商人。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Let's experience the basic 6 jobs, Swordman, Thief, Acolyte, Mage, Archer and Merchant and see what those jobs can do.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
来体验一下剑士、盗贼、服事、魔法师、弓箭手和商人这 6 种基础职业，看看他们各自能做什么。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Behind me, there are people dispatched from each of the basic Job Guilds.
These people will give you instruction manuals that allow you to experience some limited skills of each job.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
我身后有各个基础职业公会派来的代表。
他们会提供说明手册，让您体验各职业的部分技能。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Equip a manual of the job which you want to experience, and you will be able to use some basic skills of that corresponding job.
Try those skills and decide which job to choose.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
装备想体验的职业手册，就能使用该职业的一些基础技能。
试试这些技能，再决定要选择哪个职业。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Have you tried the skills in the Manuals?
If you want to hear information about each job, talk to the people dispatched by the Job Guilds.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您试过手册里的技能了吗？
想了解各职业的话，可以和职业公会派来的代表交谈。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
I think you've learned enough, do you want to quit and go to your first town?
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
我想您已经学得差不多了。要结束训练，前往第一个城镇吗？

scripts.text: I will stay little longer.
scripts.translation: 我想再待一会儿

scripts.text: I want to quit and go to the town.
scripts.translation: 我想结束训练，前往城镇

scripts.text:
[Brade]
It's ok to stay here and practice until you think you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您可以留在这里继续练习，直到觉得准备好了为止。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Try using the job manuals to find out the characteristics of each job's skills.
I will restore your HP and SP... Keep it up.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
试试职业手册里的技能，了解各职业技能的特点。
我会为您恢复 HP 和 SP...继续努力。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Looks like you are ready.
I guess you have made up your mind, huh?
Well, where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
看来您准备好了。
您应该已经决定好要选哪个职业了吧？
那么，您想去哪个城镇？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 梦罗克

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Prontera, the Capital city of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
Take care and god bless you on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
普隆德拉，卢恩·米德加尔特王国的首都。
一路保重，愿神明保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The Desert Town, Morocc...
There's lots of hidden stories within that town.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
沙漠之城梦罗克...
这座城里藏着许多故事。
一路保重。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You've selected Payon.
God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
您选择了斐扬。
愿神明保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Alberta, the Port City.
It's the main hub of all trades.
If you want to meet with other civilizations, you have to go to Alberta first.
Well then, god bless you on your soul.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
艾尔贝塔，港口之城，也是各地贸易的枢纽。
想与其他文明交流，就得先去艾尔贝塔。
那么，愿神明保佑您的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Geffen, the City of Magic.
Geffen Tower in the middle of the city is nice.
I will send you near the Geffen fountain.
May Goddess Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
吉芬，魔法之城。
城中央的吉芬塔很壮观。
我会把您送到吉芬喷泉附近。
愿女神芙蕾雅保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Yeah... Think with prudence.
...Meet up with the people from each guild.
scripts.translation:
[布雷德]
嗯...请慎重考虑。
...去和各公会的成员见见面吧。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I won't help you until you finish Brade's instructions.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
完成布雷德的指导课程后，我才能帮您。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: About Swordman Class.
scripts.translation: 关于剑士职业

scripts.text: Job change to Swordman.
scripts.translation: 转职为剑士

scripts.text: Got any quests?
scripts.translation: 有什么任务吗

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Literally, Swordman means one, who
is specialized in wielding swords.
But they can also choose to use spears if they so choose.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
顾名思义，剑士擅长使用剑。
不过，想用长矛也可以。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
We possesses strong physical strength.
So naturally we can equip heavy armors and weapons.
Most weapon classes, except for bows and rods,
are equippable by our class.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
我们体格强健，自然能装备沉重的防具和武器。
除了弓和法杖，大多数类型的武器我们都能装备。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
The only weakness of the Swordman class is that they cannot use magic spells.
But we've compensated for that by using elemental weapons.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
剑士唯一的弱点是不会使用魔法。
不过，我们可以用属性武器弥补这一点。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
The merits of being a Swordman is the enormous amount of HP we have.
Most of us can bear the grunt of our enemies' attacks with relative ease.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
剑士的一大优势是 HP 很高。
大多数剑士都能轻松承受敌人的猛烈攻击。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
And we are unrivaled when it comes to one-on-one melee combat.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
说到一对一的近身战斗，我们无人能敌。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Anyone who chooses to be a Swordman will likely play the role of the tank. It is our duty to protect the weak.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
剑士通常会担任坦克，保护弱小是我们的职责。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
As a Swordman you can advance to a ^8E2323Knight^000000 or ^8E2323Crusader^000000 class as your 2nd class profession.
And just recently third professions have been discovered.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
剑士可以进阶为^8E2323骑士^000000或^8E2323十字军^000000这两种二转职业。
最近也出现了三转职业。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Try the Swordman skills listed in the manual.
Open your skill menu by pressing Alt + S
Make sure it is in list mode by clicking the minimize button on the top right corner of the Skill Menu.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
试试手册中列出的剑士技能。
按 Alt + S 打开技能菜单。
点击技能菜单右上角的最小化按钮，切换到列表模式。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
If you're interested in being a Swordman, I'll offer you this manual.
Do you want to try the skills of a Swordman?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
如果您有兴趣成为剑士，我可以给您一本剑士手册。
想试试剑士的技能吗？

scripts.text: I'll try the Swordman skills.
scripts.translation: 我想试试剑士技能

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Here is the Swordman manual.
I'll just take any manuals from any other classes you have.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
这是剑士手册。
我会收回您身上其他职业的手册。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
After equipping the Manual, open your Skill menu by pressing ALT+S.
Make sure to minimize your Skill tree by clicking the '-' button on the top right corner of the Skill Tree Window.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
装备手册后，按 Alt + S 打开技能菜单。
点击技能树窗口右上角的“-”按钮，将技能树最小化。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Hum. Do you think so?
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our lives.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Swordman skills.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
嗯，您是这么想的吗？
好吧，我理解。选择职业是人生中的大事。
想体验剑士技能时，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Do you really want to change your job to Swordman?
If you want to be a Swordman, I'll send you to the Swordman Association immediately.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
您真的想转职为剑士吗？
如果想成为剑士，我马上送您去剑士协会。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I think you have enough job levels, of course, right?
Do you want to stop your training now and go to the Swordman Association?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
您的职业等级应该够了吧？
现在要结束训练，前往剑士协会吗？

scripts.text: I'll consider it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text: I'll go to the Swordman Association.
scripts.translation: 送我去剑士协会

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Please try enough instruction manuals from each job class and consider it carefully.
Of course, you're always welcomed.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
请多试试各职业的手册，再仔细考虑。
当然，我们随时欢迎您。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I see.
Then I'll end your training process and send you to the Swordman Guild.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
我明白了。
那么，我结束您的训练，把您送去剑士公会。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
You want me to give you a quest?
Umm. Let me see.
Ok! Hunt a couple of Picky monsters around here?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
想让我给您一个任务吗？
嗯...我看看。
好！去附近猎杀几只小鸡吧？

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou received a hunting request from a staff of the Swordman Guild.
You can check the contents of the quest from the quest information window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff您接到了剑士公会职员发布的狩猎委托。
请在任务信息窗口中查看任务内容。^000000

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Use the 'Bash' skill in the Swordman manual.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available Swordman skills.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
使用剑士手册中的“狂击”技能。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，再点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff"-"^000000 按钮将其最小化，即可查看可用的剑士技能。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Talk to Trainer Brutus if you want to fight stronger monsters.
I'll wait for you here.
Wish you a good luck.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
想挑战更强的魔物，就去找训练师布鲁图斯。
我会在这里等您。
祝您好运。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Great.
I think that you're good enough to be a Swordman.
I'll give you some potions as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
很好。
我看您已经具备成为剑士的实力了。
我会给您一些药水作为奖励。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Hunt two Picky monsters.
You can find them in the more difficult training grounds by talking to Trainer Brutus.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
猎杀两只小鸡。
去找训练师布鲁图斯，就能进入难度更高的训练场找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I think you finished that quest already, right?
You'll experience more of these quests as you grow as an adventurer in the world.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
您已经完成那个任务了吧？
随着您在这个世界中不断成长，还会遇到更多这样的任务。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Your training is now complete.
If you choose to become a Swordman I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
训练结束了。
如果您决定成为剑士，祝您好运。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
抱歉，我现在没有任务可以交给您。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
If you have any questions about the Swordman class, please ask me.
The Swordman Guild is waiting for novices like you.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
对剑士职业有任何疑问，都可以问我。
剑士公会正等着像您这样的初心者加入。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
You look like you are not done with Instructor Brade's lessons.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您似乎还没完成指导员布雷德的课程。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: What is an Acolyte?
scripts.translation: 什么是服事

scripts.text: Job change to Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 转职为服事

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
An Acolyte is someone who worships the goddess Freya sacrificing themselves to help others.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
服事是信奉女神芙蕾雅、愿意牺牲自己帮助他人的人。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Acolytes use supportive skills to make combat easier.
It is essential to have an Acolyte in any successful party.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
服事擅长使用辅助技能，让战斗更加轻松。
想要顺利组队冒险，服事是不可或缺的伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
^8E2323As an Acolyte, you can upgrade your future job to Priest or Monk^8E2323.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
^8E2323服事之后可以转职为牧师或武僧^8E2323。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Try the Acolyte Skills with the manual you have. It will help you understand the job easier.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
用手中的手册试试服事技能，更容易了解这个职业。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，再点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按钮将其最小化，即可查看可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
If you want, I can give you a skill manual to experience what it is like to be an Acolyte.
Would you like to experience the skills of an Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
如果您愿意，我可以给您一本技能手册，体验服事的技能。
您想试试服事技能吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，请给我一本

scripts.text: No, I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 不了，我没兴趣

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Here you go, the instruction manual of an Acolyte.
I will take away those other job's manuals while you study this one.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
给您，这是服事手册。
您体验这本手册时，我会收回其他职业的手册。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
在物品栏窗口中双击技能手册，将它装备起来。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，再点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按钮将其最小化，即可查看可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to know about Acolytes.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
嗯，您是这么想的吗？
好吧，我理解。选择职业是人生中的大事。
想了解服事的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Do you really want to become an Acolyte?
If you do, I will send you to Prontera's Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您真的想成为服事吗？
如果确定了，我就送您去普隆德拉的光耀之堂。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Of course, I assume you have enough job levels to become an Acolyte right?
Would you like to quit the Training Process and go to the Prontera's Sanctuary?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您的职业等级应该已经达到服事的转职要求了吧？
要结束训练，前往普隆德拉的光耀之堂吗？

scripts.text: Let me reconsider.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text: I will go to the Sanctuary.
scripts.translation: 送我去光耀之堂

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
You should try out each job's manuals.
Go through them thoroughly and decide carefully.
Of course, I will welcome you anytime.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您可以试试各职业的手册，仔细体验后再做决定。
当然，随时欢迎您来找我。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
That's great.
Then I will completely end the Training Process and send you to Prontera's Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
太好了。
那么，我结束您的训练，送您去普隆德拉的光耀之堂。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
If you have any questions about Acolytes, please ask me anytime.
Our God, Odin awaits adventurers like you.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
关于服事职业有任何疑问，随时都可以问我。
我们的神奥丁正等待着像您这样的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You look like you are not done with Instructor Brade's lessons.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
您似乎还没完成指导员布雷德的课程。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: About the Thief Class.
scripts.translation: 关于盗贼职业

scripts.text: I want to be a Thief.
scripts.translation: 我想成为盗贼

scripts.text: Got any Quests?
scripts.translation: 有什么任务吗

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves are experts at using Dagger class weapons.
They strike quickly and easily evade attacks from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
盗贼擅长使用短剑类武器。
他们出手迅速，也能轻松闪避敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves can learn skills that allow them to hide from their enemies or steal items from monsters.
They are also feared for their use of poison, which slowly weakens their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
盗贼可以学习隐匿身形或从魔物身上偷取物品的技能。
他们还擅长使用毒药，能逐渐削弱敌人，因此令人闻风丧胆。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
In jeopardy, or in the case that thieves do not want to reveal themselves,
they can even use their skill to hide themselves easily.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
遇到危险，或是不想暴露行踪时，
盗贼还能轻松施展技能隐藏自己。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves can change their jobs to ^8E2323Assassins^000000 or ^8E2323Rogues^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
盗贼可以转职为^8E2323刺客^000000或^8E2323流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
The class manual can help you understand what it is to be a Thief by using the skills that are essential to all Thieves.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
职业手册介绍了盗贼必备的技能，能帮助您了解盗贼的战斗方式。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you want, I'll give you a Thief skill manual.
Would you like to experience the skills of a Thief?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
如果您愿意，我可以给您一本盗贼技能手册。
想试试盗贼的技能吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I would.
scripts.translation: 好，我想试试

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Here, please take the Thief manual.
I'll just take the other class manuals while I'm at it.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
请收下这本盗贼手册。
我也顺便收回其他职业的手册。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
在物品栏中双击技能手册，将它装备起来。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 打开技能树，再点击窗口右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按钮将其最小化，即可查看可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Oh, are you sure?
Class selection is very important so please consider it carefully.
If you want to ask about Thieves, please talk to me any time.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
哦，您确定吗？
选择职业非常重要，请仔细考虑。
想了解盗贼的话，随时都可以来找我。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Do you really want to be a Thief?
If so, I will send you to the Thief Guild immediately.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
您真的想成为盗贼吗？
如果确定了，我马上送您去盗贼公会。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You already reached the required job level, didn't you?
Do you want to finish the Novice training and go to the Thief Guild?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
您的职业等级已经达到要求了吧？
要结束初心者训练，前往盗贼公会吗？

scripts.text: Let me consider it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，送我去

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Have you tried all of the class manuals yet?
If you're undecided what job to take on I suggest you try talking to all the Guides first.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
您已经试过所有职业的手册了吗？
如果还没决定转职方向，我建议您先和所有向导都聊一聊。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Ok, I see.
Welcome. Then your Novice training is totally complete and you will be sent to the Thief Guild immediately.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
好，我明白了。
欢迎加入！初心者训练到此结束，我马上送您去盗贼公会。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Quests?
Hmm, what will be good for you?
How about hunting some Willows.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
想接任务吗？
嗯...什么任务适合您呢？
去猎杀几只树精怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You can't cheat this so make sure to kill 5 Willows. When you're done come and talk to me again.
If you talk to Trainer Brutus, he can send you to a more difficult training ground where there are Willows to hunt.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
这个任务可不能投机取巧，请务必猎杀 5 只树精。完成后再来找我。
训练师布鲁图斯可以送您去难度更高、树精出没的训练场。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you equip the Thief manual, you can have the effect of the skill, Double Attack.
Double Attack and Hide are the main skills of the Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
装备盗贼手册后，您就能使用二刀连击技能。
二刀连击和隐匿是盗贼的主要技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You are very strong.
These are not many but let me give you a reward for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
您真厉害。
虽然奖励不多，还是请收下，感谢您的努力。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Hunt 5 Willows and then come talk to me to finish your quest.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
猎杀 5 只树精，然后回来找我交任务。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
I think you finished that quest already, right?
You'll experience more of these quests as you grow as an adventurer in the world.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
您已经完成那个任务了吧？
随着您在这个世界中不断成长，还会遇到更多这样的任务。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Your training is now complete.
If you choose to become a Thief I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
训练结束了。
如果您决定成为盗贼，祝您好运。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
抱歉，我现在没有任务可以交给您。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you have something to ask about the Thief job, feel free to ask me.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼公会成员]
对盗贼职业有任何疑问，都可以来问我。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You are still in the process of training with sir Brad.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
您还在布雷德先生那里接受训练。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Tell me about Merchants
scripts.translation: 介绍一下商人职业

scripts.text: I want to be a Merchant.
scripts.translation: 我想成为商人

scripts.text: Give me a Quest.
scripts.translation: 给我一个任务

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Merchant? Simply put, he sells goods and makes money.
That's the main focus for any Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
商人？简单来说，就是买卖货物、赚取利润。
这就是商人最主要的工作。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
We have special skills for making money.
We can buy goods at a lower price
and sell them at a higher price.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
我们有专门用来赚钱的技能。
可以买得便宜些，
再卖得贵一些。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Also Merchants can have Carts
that we can store lots of items in.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
商人还可以使用手推车，
存放大量物品。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
^8E2323Merchants can transform to a Blacksmith
^8E2323or an Alchemist^000000 as their second job.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
^8E2323商人可以转职为铁匠

您想成为商人吗？

我们随时欢迎您加入！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

太好了。

Huh? Quest??
Humm... What would be suited for you...?
Ok, then bring me ^5d5dff300 zeny^000000 by selling some of your items to the Potato Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
嗯？任务？
嗯...什么任务适合您呢...？
这样吧，把一些物品卖给土豆商人，凑齐^5d5dff300 Zeny^000000交给我。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
If you equipped the Merchant manual you have the ability to use the 'Overcharge' and 'Discount' skills.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
装备商人手册后，您就能使用“高价卖出”和“低价买进”技能。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I will wait for you here.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
我会在这里等您。
祝您好运！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Excellent!
Zeny is the currency of Midgard.
You can make zeny by selling loot as well as through making smart business decisions.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
太棒了！
Zeny 是米德加尔特的货币。
您可以出售战利品赚钱，也可以通过精明的生意赚取利润。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
We can use extremely powerful skills with zeny!
Mammonite! That is our ultimate attack skill!!
We basically paste money on the weapon and then strike the enemy. Death by Zeny! Nyahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
花 Zeny 就能施展威力惊人的技能！
金钱攻击！这是我们的终极攻击技能！
简单说，就是把钱砸在武器上，再狠狠打向敌人。让敌人死在 Zeny 之下！呀哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
By the way, you have done an excellent job. So, I should give you something... What would be good?
Alright! What about Phracon?
Phracon is a metallic element which you can use for refining weapons.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
对了，您表现得非常出色，应该给您点奖励...送什么好呢？
好，就给您一块铝！
铝是用于精炼武器的金属材料。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

Zeny 是米德加尔特的货币。
您可以出售战利品赚钱，也可以通过精明的生意赚取利润。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
击败魔物就能获得战利品，之后还可以把战利品卖掉赚钱！
商人真是个有价值的职业，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Why don't you try to be a Merchant? Making money is not easy but it will be a great experience!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
何不试着成为商人？赚钱并不容易，但一定会是很棒的体验！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You have already completed the quest.
Once you enter the main world, you can get various exciting quests there!
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
您已经完成任务了。
进入主世界后，还能接到各种有趣的任务！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I think you're strong enough now to change your job right? Hahahaha don't waste too much time here Novice.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
我看您已经有足够的实力转职了，对吧？哈哈哈，初心者，别在这里待太久。

scripts.text:

I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
抱歉，我现在没有任务可以交给您。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
If you have any questions about Merchants, feel free to ask me.
I think you could be a rich Merchant. AhHahaha.
scripts.translation:
[商人公会成员]
对商人职业有任何疑问，尽管来问我。
我看您有潜力成为富商呢。啊哈哈哈。

scripts.text:

You are still in the process of training with sir Brade.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
您还在布雷德先生那里接受训练。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Tell me about Archers
scripts.translation: 介绍一下弓箭手职业

scripts.text: I want to be an Archer
scripts.translation: 我想成为弓箭手

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Archers have specialized skills by using a Bow and have a variety of powerful skills.
Archers are good at staying back and picking off their targets.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
弓箭手擅长使用弓，也拥有多种强力技能。
他们善于在后方保持距离，逐个击倒目标。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Archers don't have great
vitality so they have to keep
their distance from enemies.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
弓箭手的体质不算出众，
所以必须与敌人保持距离。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
On the other hand, Archers are attentive and have incredibly accurate eyes.
So once they are ready to attack, they can kill enemies before they're even aware of their presence.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
不过，弓箭手观察敏锐、目光精准。
一旦瞄准目标，就能在敌人察觉之前将其击倒。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
^8E2323Archers can transform to many second jobs like a Hunter.
Besides Hunters, Archers can transform to a Bard, if they are male.
They can transform to a Dancer, if they are female^000000.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
^8E2323弓箭手可以转职为猎人等二转职业。男性弓箭手可以转职为诗人，女性弓箭手则可以转职为舞娘^000000。

scripts.text:

I think you should test Archer skills before you decide what to do.
I can provide you our test skill manual.
scripts.translation:

决定之前，建议您先体验弓箭手技能。
我可以给您一本技能体验手册。

Would like to test Archer skills?

您要登记体验技能吗？
想试试弓箭手技能吗？

scripts.text: I want to test Archer skills.
scripts.translation: 我想试试弓箭手技能

scripts.translation: 不了，我不想试

您体验期间，我会暂时收回其他职业的手册。

对弓箭手有任何疑问，尽管来问我。
年轻的初心者，您一定能成为出色的弓箭手。

您还在指导员布雷德那里接受训练。

What can I help you with?

有什么可以帮您？

scripts.translation: 给我一个任务

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Mages are those who can use magic when they need to protect their friends.
Mages can curse enemies using the elements of fire, water, earth and thunder magic.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
魔法师能在需要保护同伴时施展魔法。
他们可以操纵火、水、地、雷等属性的魔法攻击敌人。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
However they cannot equip other weapons but staffs and books.
Because they are too delicate
to carry heavy weapons.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
不过，他们只能装备法杖和书本，
因为身体较为纤弱，无法携带沉重的武器。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
But they can cover this weakness
by their remarkable magic skills.
That is why many people want
to become a Mage!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
不过，魔法师能以卓越的魔法技巧弥补这一弱点。
因此，许多人都想成为魔法师！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Mages have to be in their guild for guild's power and honor.
This is one of reasons why Mages are popular in any parties and guilds.
Why don't you become a Mage?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
魔法师需要加入公会，为公会贡献力量、争取荣誉。
这也是魔法师在队伍和公会中广受欢迎的原因之一。
您也来当魔法师吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
^8E2323Mages can transform to Wizards
^8E2323or Sages as their second job^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
^8E2323魔法师可以转职为巫师
^8E2323或贤者，成为二转职业^000000。

决定之前，建议您先体验魔法师技能。

您想登记体验魔法师的技能吗？
想试试魔法师技能吗？

这是魔法师手册。
我会收回您其他职业的登记表和手册。

您想成为魔法师吗？
好，我马上送您去吉芬的魔法师公会。

等等，您确认过自己的职业等级了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, complete my training.

我们随时欢迎您加入！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
太好了。
那么，我结束您的训练，马上送您去吉芬的魔法师公会。

scripts.text:

Would you like to hunt Lunatics by using Bolt skills?
scripts.translation:

嗯？任务？
嗯...什么任务适合您呢...？
要不要用箭术类技能猎杀疯兔？

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou have received a Hunting quest from the Mage Guide.

scripts.translation:
^4d4dff您接到了魔法师向导发布的狩猎任务。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]

I will wait for you here.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
您可以使用魔法师手册中介绍的“火箭术”。
我会在这里等您。
祝您好运！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

您做得非常出色。

hunt Lunatics and bring 5 clovers.
scripts.translation:

任务内容是猎杀疯兔，
并带回 5 片三叶草。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]

Once you enter the main world, you can get various exciting quests there!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
您已经完成任务了。
进入主世界后，还能接到各种有趣的任务！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
This should be enough for your training.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
这些训练应该足够了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
抱歉，我现在没有任务可以交给您。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]

对魔法师职业有任何疑问，尽管来问我。

[Bruce]
Hello?
I'm here to guide you about extra jobs and special classes.

[布鲁斯]
您好？
我来为您介绍扩展职业和特殊职业。

For special classes, there are Taekwon Boy, Taekwon Girl, Ninja, Supernovice, Gunslinger.
Which job description do you want to hear?
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
特殊职业包括跆拳少年、跆拳少女、忍者、超级初心者和神枪手。

scripts.text: Taekwon

scripts.text: Ninja
scripts.translation: 忍者

scripts.text: Super Novice

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
It's a job that usually uses a lot of kicking skills.
It belongs to special class and later you can change your job into Taekwon Master which has much stronger attack skills.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
这是一个以各种踢技为主的职业。
它属于特殊职业，之后可以转职为攻击力更强的跆拳宗师。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
There is a secondary class to choose from called Soul Linker which also has strong attacks.
You can decide that later when you get stronger.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
之后还可以转职为悟灵士，这个职业同样擅长攻击。
等您变强之后再决定也不迟。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Ninja's specialty is rapid movement.
They specialize in using throwing weapons.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
忍者擅长快速移动，
也精通投掷武器。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Ninjas are kind of a hybrid class that can use various dodge skills with the capability of both physical and magical attacks depending on their preference.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
忍者是兼具多种能力的职业，可以施展各种闪避技能，也能根据个人喜好进行物理或魔法攻击。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The biggest attraction of the stronger Novice, called Super Novice, is their pull to mediocrity.
They are the proverbial Jack-of-all-Trades but Master of none.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
超级初心者是更强的初心者，最大的特色是能力全面。
他们正如俗话所说，样样都会，却没有一项特别精通。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Super Novices can learn most of the 1st job class skills.
If you become a Super Novice, you cannot change your job, which is too bad, but you can grow as a very individual character.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
超级初心者可以学习大多数一转职业技能。
成为超级初心者后就不能再转职，虽然有些可惜，但能培养出独具特色的角色。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
You can job change directly from Novice to a special class which is optimized for a long-distance attack with guns.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
您可以从初心者直接转职为特殊职业，使用枪械进行远距离攻击。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Gunslingers use all kinds of guns made in 'Einbroch', the city of steel.
I recommend this for those who want to become powerful sharpshooters.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
神枪手使用钢铁之城艾音布罗克制造的各种枪械。
如果您想成为强力的神射手，我推荐这个职业。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
If you need more information,
you can always go to ^2F4F4F'www.ragnarok.co.kr'^000000
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
想了解更多信息，
可以随时访问 ^2F4F4F'www.ragnarok.co.kr'^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
These monsters are all weak and easy to kill. But be careful, a lot of them are aggressive and out for blood!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
这些魔物都很弱，很容易击败。不过要小心，它们中有很多会主动攻击，而且十分嗜血！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
If you think monsters here are too weak for you, I can send you to another training ground where the monsters are stronger than the ones over here.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
如果您觉得这里的魔物太弱，我可以送您去另一个训练场，那里的魔物更强。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
So would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
您想试试吗？

scripts.text: Send me to another Level

scripts.text: What monsters are there?
scripts.translation: 那里有哪些魔物？

scripts.text: Cancel

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

[Trainer Brutus]
You seem eager to fight.
The monster levels increase with each level of the training grounds.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
看来您很想战斗。
训练场等级越高，魔物也越强。

scripts.text:

Level 1 has the weakest monsters.
There you'll find Porings, Drops, and Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第 1 级的魔物最弱。
那里有波利、土波利和疯兔。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 2 is more challenging.
There you'll find Porings, Lunatics, Willows, and Chonchons.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第 2 级更具挑战性。
那里有波利、疯兔、树精和苍蝇。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 3 is the same as Level 2.
There you'll find Porings, Lunatics, Willows, and Chonchons.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第 3 级和第 2 级一样。
那里有波利、疯兔、树精和苍蝇。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 4 has stronger monsters.
There you'll find Willows, Hornets, Pickys, and Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第 4 级的魔物更强。
那里有树精、蜂兵、小鸡和绿棉虫。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 5 is the same as Level 4.
There you'll find Willows, Hornets, Pickys, and Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
第 5 级和第 4 级一样。
那里有树精、蜂兵、小鸡和绿棉虫。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Hmm...?
Are you worried about going to more challenging places? That's understandable, since you're still a new adventurer. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[训练师 布鲁图斯]
嗯...？
您担心去更危险的地方吗？这也难怪，毕竟您还是一名新手冒险者。祝您好运~

You are now in the outer court yard. Please go inside the castle to begin your training.

您现在位于外庭院，请进入城堡开始训练。

scripts.text:

Come in! I would like to welcome you to the Training Grounds!
In here, you can prepare yourself for your future adventures throughout the Ragnarok world!

在这里，您可以为今后在仙境传说世界各地的冒险做好准备！

scripts.text: 'Aaaahh!! Don't hurt me ~'
